name: secskills-defense
description: DFIR and detection built on preserve-first, base-rate discipline. 22 defensive security skills for SOC analysts, incident responders, and detection engineers: alert triage, malware and shellcode analysis, memory/disk/network forensics, phishing-email analysis, Windows endpoint DFIR, Linux persistence hunting, AWS/Azure/GCP/M365-Entra incident investigation, Kubernetes defense, cloud posture hardening, threat hunting, detection-as-code (Sigma/YARA/Suricata) with real false-positive analysis, risk-based vulnerability management, and threat intelligence. Every skill fact-checked against primary sources. Pairs with secskills-core. Use when investigating a compromise, running DFIR, triaging alerts, or building detections.
